Based on your history of developing a rash to both amoxicillin and cephalexin, and your current fever with flank pain despite these antibiotics, I suspect you may have developed acute kidney injury or interstitial nephritis due to a drug reaction. Could you tell me if you have noticed any new swelling in your face or legs, or if your urine output has decreased? Also, do you have a history of allergies other than skin rashes?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis

The elevated urea and creatinine confirm acute kidney injury, and your history of a rash after taking amoxicillin and cephalexin strongly suggests drug-induced acute interstitial nephritis. This condition often presents with fever, flank pain, and renal failure shortly after starting beta-lactam antibiotics. I will now await your response regarding any swelling or changes in urine output to fully confirm the diagnosis, as I have reached the limit of 10 questions.
